title: Flag lemma and normal form at mixed wires, for AND/OR fan-in-two circuits whose AND gates have a line-free input or two point-free inputs

plain_statement: Take a circuit of AND/OR gates, each listing exactly two earlier wires, on N point then N line inputs, every AND gate with an input reading no line or two reading no point. (a) A wire reading no line ignores the lines, one reading no point ignores the points, every wire is false on the all-false input. (b) Every wire w reading both satisfies w(x, y) = w(x, 0) OR (OR over frontier h of h(0, y) AND c_h(x)) for some monotone c_h; a frontier wire reads lines, no point, and is an input of a gate reading both. Conjecture, on paper.
